ms.report:
This is the Proof of Achievement document for Milestone 3 of Soulbound Tokens Project: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lTMn0-HME7ZVz3CEoWeS9Xks5pso4duXKtLjTEpOAa8/edit?usp=sharing
There you can find:
・Open Source GitHub repo with REST API code
・AdaSouls API implementation (Front-End extended to support API)
・Documentation for REST API & Notification System
・Documentation for AdaSouls
・AdaSouls Website targeting Mainnet Cardano Network

Corrections done based on reviewers feedback
・Front-end has been updated to fix issues with Mainnet integration
・Refer to Showcase Video (https://youtu.be/ldkNd-ow-_o) to understand how front-end works and be able to mint & claim a Soulbound token. Please, keep in mind that Soulbound Tokens won't be in your wallet because they are locked in a smart contract (this is how the protocol works). Only valid stake address can claim the token, so if you can build the transaction, that means the validation works. 
・You will need 2 wallets to test, as shown in the video: one to mint and issue the token to another wallet, and this last wallet to be able to claim it.

Acceptance Criteria
・Front-End implements the AdaSouls API correctly and works as expected
・Tokens can be minted/claimed on Mainnet Cardano Network
・All documentation is ready and publicly accessible for both the REST API and the AdaSouls protocol
